user.title: Domyland — sign in with Yandex
user.description:
1. Open the link and sign in with your Yandex ID:
{auth_url}

2. After signing in Yandex will redirect you to a page (it may fail to open an app — that's fine). Copy the **whole URL** from the address bar, or the `y0_...` token from it.

3. Paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Domyland — re-authenticate

error.invalid_token_format: Couldn't parse the token. Paste a `y0_...` string or the full URL with `#access_token=`.
error.invalid_auth: Domyland rejected the token. Make sure you signed in with the right Yandex ID.

abort.already_configured: This Domyland account is already configured.

init.title: Domyland settings
init.description: Restore cameras only from your personal JSON backup. Import does not discover devices by arbitrary IDs. Camera URLs are confidential — do not share the backup. Leave the field empty if recovery is not needed.

data_description.camera_backup: The JSON must contain building_id and a cameras list. Each camera needs id, title and streamURL; image is optional. The building must be available in your account. URLs are saved only in the integration's local storage, not in its options.

error.invalid_camera_backup: Could not import cameras. Check the JSON, building access, unique positive IDs and nonempty camera titles. streamURL must use HTTPS without credentials on ujin.tech or mysmartflat.ru or their subdomains; image, if provided, must be a string.
